subject: Error when reading a shapefile when my app is deployed to shiny

messages.author: 75100463b7eff618
messages.subject: Error when reading a shapefile when my app is deployed to shiny
parts:
(Apologies for the cross posting. (posted on Shiny Webframework for R))

Hi all
I have an app which works fine on my laptop, but falls over when I deploy it to my account. The issue seems to be when I read in a shapefile.

I have tried both the readShapeSpatial command from the maptools package as well as readOGR from rgdal
The app looks to deploy, tries to open, but then says it is Disconnected from the server

When using readShapeSpatial the error log I get tells me that among other things:
2016-02-22T22:12:29.360858+00:00 shinyapps[84755]: Warning: Error in getinfo.shape: Error opening SHP file
2016-02-22T22:12:29.365703+00:00 shinyapps[84755]: Error in getinfo.shape(fn) : Error opening SHP file

However on my desk top that works fine. e.g. (The shapefile open in ArcMap etc as well so I t=don't thing it is an issue with the shapefile itself.
> getinfo.shape("Shapefiles\\Cape_2_City_Project")
Shapefile type: Polygon, (5), # of Shapes: 1

FYI, when I try it using readOGR I get:
2016-02-22T22:21:58.635872+00:00 shinyapps[84755]: Warning: Error in ogrInfo: Cannot open file
2016-02-22T22:21:58.640908+00:00 shinyapps[84755]: Error in ogrInfo(dsn = dsn, layer = layer, encoding = encoding, use_iconv = use_iconv,  :

I have upated the packages and I send them all as part of my server.R file. And I have all the components for the shapefile (dbf, shp etc)
I have also tried a different shapefile but get the same issue.
Any suggestions would be greatly appreciated.
Andrew

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Error when reading a shapefile when my app is deployed to shiny
parts:
Andrew,

Can you ensure your filenames match exactly? Shinyapps.io is case sensitive.

Also can you make sure your file is referenced relative to your application directory?

-Andy

parts:
Thanks for your response Andy
I am pretty sure that is all good. The shape-file called Cape_2_City_Project.shp etc is in a folder called Shapefiles, and I have definitely used the correct case when calling them in server.R.
But maybe my file path specification is wrong?
In my server.R file I use:
shp.area<-readShapeSpatial(".\\Shapefiles\\Cape_2_City_Project",CRS(proj4string))

Andrew

messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Error when reading a shapefile when my app is deployed to shiny
parts:
Thanks again Andy!
So it did indeed turn out to be a filepath issue. I moved the shapefile to the application directory and did away with all the slashes etc and it works.  
I feel a bit stupid really. The fact that it worked on my machine but not when deployed had me scrambling around updating packages etc whereas it was a simple case of not pointing the code in the right direction!
Andrew
